question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:
 Demur
solution:
The correct answer is: **Consent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Demur"** means to raise objections or show reluctance; it is often used to describe hesitating or declining something. (आपत्ति करना / संकोच करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She agreed to join the team without a demur, showing no hesitation.
 

 
• **"Consent"** means to agree to or approve something, often willingly or without objection. It is the opposite of showing reluctance or objection. (सहमति देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The committee gave their consent to the new policy after much discussion.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Demur"** is **"Consent"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Consent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Disagree** (असहमति जताना): To have a different opinion or to not agree with something.
 
 
• **Example:** I disagree with the idea of extending the work hours without additional pay.
 
 

 
• **Protest** (विरोध करना): To express strong objection or disapproval towards something.
 
 
• **Example:** People gathered to protest against the new tax laws.
 
 

 
• **Resist** (प्रतिरोध करना): To fight against or oppose something actively.
 
 
• **Example:** She couldn't resist the temptation to buy the designer handbag.
